Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking a Senior Data Integration Engineer to design and build robust data transformation pipelines within the Snowflake ecosystem. In this role, you will leverage your deep technical expertise to develop scalable ETL/ELT solutions, working directly within Snowflake to deliver high-quality data products that power business decisions.
 Responsibilities
Design and develop ETL/ELT pipelines natively within Snowflake without relying on external ETL tools
Build and maintain Stored Procedures, User-Defined Functions (UDFs), Dynamic Tables, and Views in Snowflake
Develop data transformation logic to support analytical and operational use cases
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable Python code to support data integration workflows
Optimize Snowflake performance, including query tuning and resource management
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Ensure data quality, integrity, and reliability across all pipelines
Document technical designs, processes, and data flows for team knowledge sharing
 Requirements
3+ years of experience in data engineering or data integration roles
Strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake ETL/ELT development
Proficiency in building Snowflake Stored Procedures, User-Defined Functions (UDFs), and Dynamic Tables
Skills in developing Views and complex data transformation logic within Snowflake
Experience building data transformation pipelines directly in Snowflake without external ETL tools
Strong Python development skills for data processing and automation
Excellent command of written and spoken English (B2+ level)
 Nice to have
Familiarity with dbt for data transformation and modeling
Understanding of CI/CD practices and tooling
Proficiency in SQL
 We offer
Full access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
Free English classes
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
Friendly team and comfortable working environment
Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
Flexible working schedule
Opportunities for self-realization
